work.title: The Life of King Henry the Fifth
work.author: William Shakespeare

content.text: Enter the King of France, the Dauphin, the Duke of Bourbon, the Constable of France and others.

lines.text: 'Tis certain he hath pass'd the river Somme.
lines.plainText: 'Tis certain he hath pass'd the river Somme

lines.text: And if he be not fought withal, my lord,
lines.plainText: And if he be not fought withal my lord

lines.text: Let us not live in France; let us quit all
lines.plainText: Let us not live in France let us quit all

lines.text: And give our vineyards to a barbarous people.
lines.plainText: And give our vineyards to a barbarous people

lines.text: O Dieu vivant! shall a few sprays of us,
lines.plainText: O Dieu vivant shall a few sprays of us

lines.text: The emptying of our fathers' luxury,
lines.plainText: The emptying of our fathers' luxury

lines.text: Our scions put in wild and savage stock,
lines.plainText: Our scions put in wild and savage stock

lines.text: Spirt up so suddenly into the clouds,
lines.plainText: Spirt up so suddenly into the clouds

lines.text: And overlook their grafters?
lines.plainText: And overlook their grafters

lines.text: Normans, but bastard Normans, Norman bastards!
lines.plainText: Normans but bastard Normans Norman bastards

lines.text: Mort de ma vie, if they march along
lines.plainText: Mort de ma vie if they march along

lines.text: Unfought withal, but I will sell my dukedom,
lines.plainText: Unfought withal but I will sell my dukedom

lines.text: To buy a slobbery and a dirty farm
lines.plainText: To buy a slobbery and a dirty farm

lines.text: In that nook-shotten isle of Albion.
lines.plainText: In that nookshotten isle of Albion

lines.text: Dieu de batailles, where have they this mettle?
lines.plainText: Dieu de batailles where have they this mettle

lines.text: Is not their climate foggy, raw, and dull,
lines.plainText: Is not their climate foggy raw and dull

lines.text: On whom, as in despite, the sun looks pale,
lines.plainText: On whom as in despite the sun looks pale

lines.text: Killing their fruit with frowns? Can sodden water,
lines.plainText: Killing their fruit with frowns Can sodden water

lines.text: A drench for sur-rein'd jades, their barley-broth,
lines.plainText: A drench for surrein'd jades their barleybroth

lines.text: Decoct their cold blood to such valiant heat?
lines.plainText: Decoct their cold blood to such valiant heat

lines.text: And shall our quick blood, spirited with wine,
lines.plainText: And shall our quick blood spirited with wine

lines.text: Seem frosty? O, for honour of our land,
lines.plainText: Seem frosty O for honour of our land

lines.text: Let us not hang like roping icicles
lines.plainText: Let us not hang like roping icicles

lines.text: Upon our houses' thatch, whiles a more frosty people
lines.plainText: Upon our houses' thatch whiles a more frosty people

lines.text: Sweat drops of gallant youth in our rich fields!
lines.plainText: Sweat drops of gallant youth in our rich fields

lines.text: Poor we may call them in their native lords.
lines.plainText: Poor we may call them in their native lords

lines.text: By faith and honour,
lines.plainText: By faith and honour

lines.text: Our madams mock at us, and plainly say
lines.plainText: Our madams mock at us and plainly say

lines.text: Our mettle is bred out, and they will give
lines.plainText: Our mettle is bred out and they will give

lines.text: Their bodies to the lust of English youth
lines.plainText: Their bodies to the lust of English youth

lines.text: To new-store France with bastard warriors.
lines.plainText: To newstore France with bastard warriors

lines.text: They bid us to the English dancing-schools,
lines.plainText: They bid us to the English dancingschools

lines.text: And teach lavoltas high, and swift corantos;
lines.plainText: And teach lavoltas high and swift corantos

lines.text: Saying our grace is only in our heels,
lines.plainText: Saying our grace is only in our heels

lines.text: And that we are most lofty runaways.
lines.plainText: And that we are most lofty runaways

lines.text: Where is Montjoy the herald? Speed him hence.
lines.plainText: Where is Montjoy the herald Speed him hence

lines.text: Let him greet England with our sharp defiance.
lines.plainText: Let him greet England with our sharp defiance

lines.text: Up, princes! and, with spirit of honour edged
lines.plainText: Up princes and with spirit of honour edged

lines.text: More sharper than your swords, hie to the field!
lines.plainText: More sharper than your swords hie to the field

lines.text: Charles Delabreth, High Constable of France;
lines.plainText: Charles Delabreth High Constable of France

lines.text: You Dukes of Orleans, Bourbon, and of Berry,
lines.plainText: You Dukes of Orleans Bourbon and of Berry

lines.text: Alençon, Brabant, Bar, and Burgundy;
lines.plainText: Alenon Brabant Bar and Burgundy

lines.text: Jacques Chatillon, Rambures, Vaudemont,
lines.plainText: Jacques Chatillon Rambures Vaudemont

lines.text: Beaumont, Grandpré, Roussi, and Fauconbridge,
lines.plainText: Beaumont Grandpr Roussi and Fauconbridge

lines.text: Foix, Lestrale, Boucicault, and Charolois;
lines.plainText: Foix Lestrale Boucicault and Charolois

lines.text: High dukes, great princes, barons, lords, and knights,
lines.plainText: High dukes great princes barons lords and knights

lines.text: For your great seats now quit you of great shames.
lines.plainText: For your great seats now quit you of great shames

lines.text: Bar Harry England, that sweeps through our land
lines.plainText: Bar Harry England that sweeps through our land

lines.text: With pennons painted in the blood of Harfleur.
lines.plainText: With pennons painted in the blood of Harfleur

lines.text: Rush on his host, as doth the melted snow
lines.plainText: Rush on his host as doth the melted snow

lines.text: Upon the valleys, whose low vassal seat
lines.plainText: Upon the valleys whose low vassal seat

lines.text: The Alps doth spit and void his rheum upon.
lines.plainText: The Alps doth spit and void his rheum upon

lines.text: Go down upon him, you have power enough,
lines.plainText: Go down upon him you have power enough

lines.text: And in a captive chariot into Rouen
lines.plainText: And in a captive chariot into Rouen

lines.text: Bring him our prisoner.
lines.plainText: Bring him our prisoner

lines.text: This becomes the great.
lines.plainText: This becomes the great

lines.text: Sorry am I his numbers are so few,
lines.plainText: Sorry am I his numbers are so few

lines.text: His soldiers sick and famish'd in their march;
lines.plainText: His soldiers sick and famish'd in their march

lines.text: For I am sure, when he shall see our army,
lines.plainText: For I am sure when he shall see our army

lines.text: He'll drop his heart into the sink of fear
lines.plainText: He'll drop his heart into the sink of fear

lines.text: And for achievement offer us his ransom.
lines.plainText: And for achievement offer us his ransom

lines.text: Therefore, Lord Constable, haste on Montjoy,
lines.plainText: Therefore Lord Constable haste on Montjoy

lines.text: And let him say to England that we send
lines.plainText: And let him say to England that we send

lines.text: To know what willing ransom he will give.
lines.plainText: To know what willing ransom he will give

lines.text: Prince Dauphin, you shall stay with us in Rouen.
lines.plainText: Prince Dauphin you shall stay with us in Rouen

lines.text: Not so, I do beseech your Majesty.
lines.plainText: Not so I do beseech your Majesty

lines.text: Be patient, for you shall remain with us.
lines.plainText: Be patient for you shall remain with us

lines.text: Now forth, Lord Constable and princes all,
lines.plainText: Now forth Lord Constable and princes all

lines.text: And quickly bring us word of England's fall.
lines.plainText: And quickly bring us word of England's fall
